Ronke trusted a rug. Not even a particularly convincing rug.

Ronke under a pile of chips. Somehow still making eye contact.

Ronke going up. Unfortunately this is not helping.
Level {level}. Ronke was feeling stronke. Hard to keep that feeling while dangling from a balloon.

Ronke briefly airborne. Landing form could use work.

Ronke got to level {level}. Now staring into that eye with nothing left to say. There was more in this run.
Ronke wanted to go to the moon. Moon came to Ronke.

Ronke saw green and got excited. Ronke is inside the green now.
Up to level {level}, then bottled by a moth. Ronke would like some room to be annoyed.
Level {level}, stuck under Fomoth. Ronke can still see outside. That somehow makes it worse.
Ronke thought snake wearing coins would be nice. Ronke is easy to impress.
Ronke gets to level {level} and the fancy snake tips a bag on his head. Could just say hello.
Gone at level {level}, covered in Oracobra's coins. Ronke wanted a little longer on his feet.
Rabbit did a magic trick. Ronke is the thing that disappeared under the chips.
Ronke made it to level {level}. Rabbit made Ronke mostly disappear. Nobody clap.
Level {level}, buried in chips. Ronke had more of this run left in his head.
Alien brought three glowing wallets. Ronke brought one very tired face.
Level {level}. Ronke was finally getting somewhere. Now stuck staring at three alien wallets.
Level {level}, staring at Signalien's glowing wallets. Ronke was so happy with this run.
Ronke got buried in memes. Please find a slightly less accurate one for the top.
Ronke reaches level {level}. The memes reach his neck. Starting to take this personally.
Level {level}. Ronke buried under laughing faces. Wasn't ready for this run to be the joke.
Ronke looked at shiny coin. Ronke should have looked at giant hole.
Level {level}, then Shillfish and a hole in the floor. Ronke was just getting somewhere.
Ronke falling at level {level}, phone still up. Please let this run have a nicer last picture.
Ronke brought a sack to a bat fight. Sack doing absolutely nothing.
Level {level}. Still hugging the sack while Copiumbat breathes on Ronke. Great plan.
That green cloud at level {level}. Ronke held on to the sack like it could save the run.
Ronke wanted to roll. Dice rolled Ronke into a sitting position.
Level {level}. Two giant dice, one gremlin, zero room for Ronke's growing confidence.
Pinned between dice at level {level}. Ronke was starting to feel stronke. Hard to look at this.
Ronke lost to Spinweasel. Now using the velvet rope as a very bad bed.
Level {level}. Ronke was moving nicely. Now the velvet rope is holding Ronke up.
Level {level}. All that fight left in Ronke, and Spinweasel leaves him folded over a rope.
Ronke thought green poodle looked friendly. Ronke now part of the spill.
Green bubbles everywhere at level {level}. Ronke just wanted to keep standing. Such a small request.
Level {level}. Ronke still holding the phone up. Everything else went down with the green bubbles.
Ronke lying flat beside a bug. Bug somehow looks more ready for the day.
Level {level}. Ronke was feeling good. Now a spotty bug gets to watch him melt into the table.
Level {level}. Ronke flat on the table, still holding one chip. Hard to let go of this run.
Ronke poked the phone and got bugs. Ronke should stop poking things.
Ronke reaches level {level} and the phone starts becoming bugs. Very hard to stay bullash.
Level {level}. Ronke staring at the phone coming apart. This run deserved a quieter ending.
Ronke has been put to bed. Bed is casino table. Blanket is purple moth nonsense.
Face-down at level {level} while a purple moth hovers. Ronke would like to be annoyed but is too sleepy.
Level {level}. Ronke face down under that purple glow. Didn't think this was where it would end.
Ronke thought moth on head was cute. Ronke has questions now.
Ronke makes level {level}. Golden moth makes itself comfortable on his head. This is getting disrespectful.
Level {level}. Ronke wasn't done. That little golden moth still sitting there like nothing happened.
Ronke halfway down a hole. Tiny chip man smiling. Bad day to be the bigger guy.
The chip is laughing. Ronke is halfway into a hole at level {level}. Suddenly less funny.
Level {level}. Ronke still reaching from that hole. Little chip can stop laughing now. Please.
Ronke sitting in a pile of metal blocks. Somehow this is the comfy option.
Level {level}. Ronke felt unstoppable. Now giant block lizard watching Ronke sit very still.
Level {level}. Ronke sitting in the wreckage, phone still in hand. Really wanted more from this run.
Ronke trusted a paper plank. In front of a pirate. Ronke hearing it now.
Level {level}. Run was going well until Ronke found himself balancing on paper over a pit.
Level {level}. Ronke slipping off the paper plank. Pirate still grinning. That part hurts extra.
Ronke on the floor. Smiling pipe lady still filming. Please get the good angle.
Down on the floor at level {level}. Ronke looks up. Of course the pipe lady has her phone out.
Level {level}. Ronke sitting dazed while the pipe lady films. Could she put the phone down for a second.
Ronke thought rug man looked friendly. Look at that stupid grin.
Ronke was finding his feet at level {level}. Rugmogul brought the whole carpet.
Level {level}. All that way, then a rug on a conveyor. Ronke can't bear that grin right now.
Housebeast brought a whole table. Ronke brought his little phone.
Level {level}. Ronke finally settled in. Housebeast started lifting the furniture.
Ronke under the table at level {level}, phone still up. Hard to let this run go.
Ronke fit in sack. Not the discovery Ronke wanted today.
Ronke was going places at level {level}. Apparently into Seedthief's sack.
Level {level}. All that way, then into a sack. Ronke not finding this very funny.
Ronke now comes in the long, flat size. Thanks, Sandwichbot.
Level {level} should feel like progress. Ronke feels like sandwich filling.
Flattened by Sandwichbot at level {level}. Ronke can't make this one funny yet.
Ronke upside down. Chips still stacked nicely. Glad someone is okay.
Ronke was getting somewhere at level {level}. Minebot put that somewhere upside down.
Level {level}. Minebot left Ronke upside down. This run mattered more than Ronke expected.
Ronke in bucket. Fish on dry land. Something went wrong with the fishing.
Hook in mouth, monke in bucket. Ronke was doing fine before this. Level {level}.
Level {level}. Phishmonger reeled Ronke in. Ronke wasn't ready for this run to end.
Ronke blinked. Frontrunner already somewhere else. Ronke still pointing.
Level {level}. Ronke finally found a little rhythm. Frontrunner left him in the dust.
Frontrunner already gone. Ronke still standing there at level {level}, not quite believing it's over.
Ronke pinned to wall by cards. Should have respected the paper.
Ronke was starting to feel stronke at level {level}. Cardshark put him on the wall.
Level {level}. Cards still holding Ronke up. Everything else just dropped.
Ronke saw little hearts. Ronke did not expect the dragging part.
Ronke only wanted to get past level {level}. The replies are now physically dragging him into a hole.
All those hearts, and Replygator still dragged Ronke down at level {level}. That one hurts.
Ronke saw the stop sign. Brain did not.
A stop sign would have done. Ronke gets the giant red ram at level {level}.
Level {level}. Ronke wasn't ready to stop. That sign feels personal now.
Ronke checked the phone. Floor checked out.
Level {level}. Phone still up, floor suddenly gone. Ronke would like the bird to stop watching.
Level {level}. Ronke falling, Floorvulture watching. This run deserved more floor.
Ronke tried to catch Clickjackal. Carpet caught Ronke.
Level {level}. Ronke had a nice pace going. Now face down on the carpet. Lovely.
Level {level}. Clickjackal still running. Ronke still reaching. Hard to look at this one.
Ronke trusted a rat with a big red button. Ronke can hear how that sounds.
Level {level}. Going well until Ronke noticed who was holding the other end of the cable.
Level {level}. Ronke made it this far. A little rat with a button got the last word.
Ronke met Coinflipper. Coin flipped Ronke.
Level {level}. Ronke was feeling stronke. Now getting thrown around by a coin.
Level {level}. Ronke got this far just to go flying off a giant coin. Hard to believe this is the end.
Ronke followed the big green arrow. Green apparently includes holes.
Level {level}. Ronke was feeling good about the green arrow. Then the floor ended.
Level {level}. Ronke believed that green arrow right to the edge. That part hurts.

Level {level}. Ronke was standing tall. Now sitting in paper while Copycat looks pleased.
Level {level}. Ronke can't even get up from this paper pile yet. Cat could stop smiling.
Ronke checked the bag again. Still just bag.
Ronke holds the empty bag up at level {level}. Perhaps looking into it harder will help.
Level {level}. Ronke keeps looking inside the bag. Not quite ready to put it down.
Ronke needs a lie down. Chipmunk needs smaller cheeks.

Level {level}. Ronke leaning on the table, trying to take it in. Chipmunk still chewing.

Level {level}. Ronke was doing fine until the buttons started coming out of the phone.
Level {level}. Ronke got this far. That tiny bug and those stupid buttons are all he can think about now.

Level {level}. All that momentum and Dustmidge just blows Ronke back into the dust.
Level {level}. Ronke was still reaching forward. Dustmidge had already sent him the other way.

Ronke has been picked up like laundry. Hard to look stronke from here.
